WITH initial_data AS (
    SELECT 
        s.CDSCode,
        s.School,
        s.City,
        f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)` AS FreeMealPct,
        f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)` AS FRPMPct
    FROM 
        schools s
    INNER JOIN 
        frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
    WHERE 
        s.State = 'CA' AND s.City = 'Los Angeles'
)

FROM initial_data
WHERE FreeMealPct > 500 / 100 AND FRPMPct < 700 / 100;	----- bird -----	california_schools

WITH approved_loans AS (
    SELECT account_id, MIN(amount) AS min_amount
    FROM loan
    WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', date) = '1997'
    GROUP BY account_id
),
lowest_approved_amount AS (
    SELECT account_id, min_amount
    FROM approved_loans
)
SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    a.frequency,
    a.date,
    l.min_amount
FROM 
    account a
JOIN 
    lowest_approved_amount l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE 
    a.account_id IN (
        SELECT account_id 
        FROM loan 
        WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', date) = '1997'
    )
ORDER BY 
    l.min_amount ASC;	----- bird -----	financial

WITH client_info AS (
    SELECT client_id, gender, birth_date
    FROM client
    WHERE client_id = 992
),
loan_details AS (
    SELECT amount, payments, status
    FROM loan
    WHERE account_id IN (
        SELECT account_id
        FROM disp
        WHERE client_id = 992
    )
),
debt_amount AS (
    SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_debt
    FROM loan
    WHERE account_id IN (
        SELECT account_id
        FROM disp
        WHERE client_id = 992
    )
),
payment_status AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN payments >= amount THEN 'Fully Paid'
            ELSE 'Pending'
        END AS payment_status
    FROM loan_details
)
SELECT 
    client_id,
    gender,
    birth_date,
    total_debt,
    payment_status
FROM 
    client_info, debt_amount, payment_status;	----- bird -----	financial

WITH c_cols AS (
    SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_salary
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
    GROUP BY c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date
),
oldest_female AS (
    SELECT client_id, MAX(birth_date) AS max_birth_date
    FROM c_cols
    GROUP BY client_id
)
SELECT cc.client_id, cc.avg_salary
FROM c_cols cc
JOIN oldest_female of ON cc.client_id = of.client_id AND cc.birth_date = of.max_birth_date
ORDER BY cc.avg_salary ASC
LIMIT 1;	----- bird -----	financial

WITH m_cols AS (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM molecule
    WHERE label = 'TR010'
),
bond_counts AS (
    SELECT bond_type, COUNT(*) AS count
    FROM bond
    INNER JOIN m_cols ON bond.molecule_id = m_cols.molecule_id
    GROUP BY bond_type
)
SELECT bond_type, count, CASE WHEN MAX(count) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS major_bond_type, 
       (SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN T1.element = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END 
        FROM atom AS T1
        INNER JOIN m_cols AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id) AS is_carcinogenic
FROM bond_counts;	----- bird -----	toxicology
